name: pi-btw
notes: Forked from the pi-btw upstream. The transcript-builder contract lives in openspec (spec transcript-builder-api).

knownDebt.reason: Upstream package-lock.json is deleted on every sync (it resurrects on each pull) and is never consumed by this pnpm monorepo; delete it again with git rm packages/pi-btw/package-lock.json after each subtree pull.
'applies distinct theme treatment' asserts truecolor ANSI and fails when COLORTERM is unset. Environment-dependent, not code; run suites with COLORTERM=truecolor.

reapplyOnSync: re-apply the pi-components migration and outcome threading in extensions/btw.ts, keeping the [BTW SESSION BOUNDARY] marker intact
adapt upstream tests asserting the upstream renderer's 'You  <text>' user-row badge format to plain-text assertions (the fork renderer has no You label)
bump upstream tests asserting SessionManager.appendMessage call counts by +1 because the fork's boundary message is also seeded
delete package-lock.json again if a future subtree pull resurrects it
keep pi-ai in devDeps as an explicit 0.83.0 (no catalog entry exists) with peerDependencies >=0.83.0 <1
run the suites with COLORTERM=truecolor, because 'applies distinct theme treatment' asserts truecolor ANSI
doNotReintroduce: do not adopt upstream's overlay renderer (buildOverlayTranscript plus its per-entry helpers): rendering stays on pi-components renderTranscriptLines
do not adopt upstream's markdownTheme/managesMouseReporting/rebuildTranscriptLines additions; SGR mouse-reporting and ownsMouseReporting stay fork-only
keep the dead removeTranscriptTurn import removed, and keep 'skills' dropped from package.json files (the directory stays to avoid subtree delete conflicts)
